subject: Rename redisOpArray to serverOpArray (#157)
reason: The change is a pure refactor: it renames the type redisOpArray to serverOpArray and the functions redisOpArrayAppend/redisOpArrayFree to serverOpArrayAppend/serverOpArrayFree in server.c and server.h, updating the two call sites (alsoPropagate, propagatePendingCommands) and a comment. The struct layout, function bodies, and all runtime behavior are identical; the names are internal C symbols not visible to clients, replication, AOF, or modules. Compilation itself proves the rename is consistent, so no fuzzer scenario can distinguish the change from its parent.
